components: A worker records a classified transient failure and attempt count.
Backoff, jitter, maximum attempts, and deadline determine the next time.
The retry remains invisible until its scheduled activation.
A worker receives the same stable job identity for safe retry.
Permanent or exhausted failures move to review or dead-letter state.
